newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish civil servants to strike on December 11.
newsitem.headline: Spanish civil servants to strike on December 11.

text.p: Spanish civil servants said on Thursday they would strike on December 11 in protest at the government's planned public sector pay freeze, a union spokesman told Reuters.
"We have agreed to call a strike for December 11," he said.

The unions said they had rejected a last-ditch offer by the conservative government to avert the strike by promising to raise 1998 and 1999 salaries in compensation for a planned 1997 pay freeze it says is necessary.
Spanish Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato told a conference on Wednesday that the government was going to do "everything possible" to avert a clash with workers.
But unions appeared determined on Thursday to take the government to task for its tough budget plan aimed at getting Spain in shape for European Monetary Union (EMU).
"This is more of a provocation than an offer," Carlos Sanchez, a representative of the Workers' Commission (CCOO), one of Spain's two biggest unions, told state radio.
